context:
Goal: cloud sessions run the current hooks.
Problem (rule): cloud sessions refresh hooks on startup, resume and compact only, not on clear or fork. A session after a clear or fork may run old hooks. Needs your word: keep this as a known limit, or open a new gap to fix.
Based on (measured): the refresh runs on startup, resume and compact only.
Departs from: main — adds a hook refresh on clear and fork, if you pick b; a keeps main.
Meanwhile: nothing waits; the lane takes no action on this until you answer.
home: lane pr-backlog wave 1; a note or a debt in the repo's debt store

options.how: File one note that cloud sessions refresh hooks on startup, resume and compact only. No change to the startup hook.
options.label: Wanted limit: record it as a note
options.lose: A stale-hook window after clear or fork.

options.gain: Hooks stay current after clear and fork.
options.how: Open a debt record. A later lane adds a hook refresh on clear and fork to the startup hook.
options.label: New gap: open a debt for a refresh on clear and fork
options.lose: New work in the startup hook.

ref: cloud session hook refresh (startup, resume, compact; not clear, fork)

shown.label: Wanted limit: record it as a note
New gap: open a debt for a refresh on clear and fork

title: Cloud hook refresh skips clear and fork: keep it as a known limit, or open a gap?
why: No real incident shows a stale hook caused harm, so a keeps main and costs nothing until one does.
